segments.an10.39:1.1: Atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an10.39:1.3: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, saṅgho bhinno hotī”ti?
segments.an10.39:1.4: “Idhānanda, bhikkhū adhammaṃ dhammoti dīpenti, dhammaṃ adhammoti dīpenti, avinayaṃ vinayoti dīpenti … pe … paññattaṃ tathāgatena apaññattaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpenti.
segments.an10.39:1.6: Te imehi dasahi vatthūhi avakassanti apakassanti āveni kammāni karonti āveni pātimokkhaṃ uddisanti.
segments.an10.39:1.7: Ettāvatā kho, ānanda, saṅgho bhinno hotī”ti.
segments.an10.39:2.1: “Samaggaṃ pana, bhante, saṅghaṃ bhinditvā kiṃ so pasavatī”ti?
segments.an10.39:3.5: Saṅghaṃ samaggaṃ bhinditvā [bhetvāna (sī. syā.), bhitvāna (ka.) cūḷava.354; itivu.18; kathāva.657] kappaṃ nirayamhi paccatī”ti.

lines: Yogakkhemā padhaṃsatīti yogehi khemato arahattato dhaṃsati vigacchati.
